page.layout: Top: printed page number "236" centred at the head, then an ornamental woodcut border. page.notes: The title block is set in mixed Fraktur and roman type; the Fraktur words are transcribed as closely as the scan allows. Long s is shown as ß where the printer used the ss ligature (Mußifen, Auß), which is the German convention and not a long-s character. "Mußifen" is uncertain: the scan may read "Mussifen" or "Mussifen" [?]. The head "etlich" is set with a printer's hyphen in the scan ("ec=lich"), which is not clearly legible. The catchword "nes" sits at the right foot, below the last line, and is not repeated in the text. No running head is printed on this page.
